outOfScope: New native modules or APK builds
Server-authoritative ranked WSS activation or Supabase SQL migrations
Changes to BP, QMP, Character Diamonds or payouts
selectionRationale: The owner supplied two real landscape Android screenshots showing double title overlays, obscured Arena controls and persistent dashboard nav; explicitly requested adjustable screens, pinch zoom and friendly map navigation. Isolated Expo in-app UI/camera repair is the lowest-risk reversible path.
acceptanceChecks: Source and Metro must compile actual Expo Android Arena screen without JSX/TypeScript errors.
Pure gesture regression covers zoom limits, drag direction, minimap jump, camera edge anchors and both portrait and landscape aspect ratios.
Arena stage must not render global dashboard bottom navigation, map return overlay or focus-app ad strip; other routes remain unchanged.
Scroll/lobby CTA, tutorial hints, music orientation exit cleanup, timed combat and economy isolation retain current permissions.
Signed native/AdMob device runtime must be separately verified before OTA or production claim.
alternativeApproaches: Replacing Expo app Arena with a standalone APK or Godot shell: rejected because one installed BUKLOD Android app is authoritative.
Global hiding of navigation or advertising: rejected because it would regress outside-Arena pages.
Unbounded zoom or locally simulated online ranked Diamond: rejected to preserve camera bounds and server-side economy.
Native dependency replacement: rejected because it would require a new verified APK instead of existing runtime-compatible JS.
